rationale: Read the full source diff against 535080033 myself. All four parts match the spec: consulting only the first router (bounded timeout, cancelled timer, profile check before the resolver so agents.default is never reached, confidence filtered to 0..1), the routing-stage guards (usable check, then escalations, then saved routerDecision; skipPluginRouters follows usability; one warning per run with storyId first), recording and logging (error/timeout/no-router not saved; exact log names and data keys; plannedProfileId captured before the router runs; existing write-back and skipPrdPersistence gate), and applying the pick (apply mode only, precedence table, clears modelTier/profileModelTier/profileModelPin/initialModelTier/initialModelPin before resolveOperatingTier). Gates and CI are green with no open findings. The one change outside the listed scope, forwarding plugins to parallel worker pipelines (c1c40a68d), does not break the spec: the parallel pre-dispatch resolveRouting callers are unchanged and the router is still consulted only by the routing stage. It is needed for the hook to run in parallel mode and is covered by an integration test that checks saving at the batch boundary. Side effect: parallel workers now get all plugins (context providers, optimizer, legacy plugin routers), as sequential runs already do. This is easy to undo and should be mentioned in the PR description.
